info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Current Account Management API
info.description: The Current Account Management API facilitates the setup and management of current accounts for consumers. This endpoint allows users to initiate the process of opening a current account, providing essential personal and financial details. Typical consumers include banking customers and financial institutions looking to streamline account creation. It supports various use cases, including customer onboarding and account verification processes.

post.summary: Create a new deposit lending current account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new current account under the deposit lending service. It facilitates the management of finances, enabling users to deposit and lend quickly and efficiently.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or modifying a current account for deposit lending. This operation allows users to specify account details and related parameters necessary for the transaction.
